title: Week 27 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “progressive tax”?
options: Presidential rejection of legislation, subject to possible congressional override.
A tax whose effective rate rises as the tax base or ability to pay rises.
A plan for measuring whether a policy caused intended results and what else occurred.
Rapid withdrawals driven by fear that an institution cannot meet obligations.
questions.explanation: Progressive tax means a tax whose effective rate rises as the tax base or ability to pay rises.
choices: Presidential rejection of legislation, subject to possible congressional override.

Rapid withdrawals driven by fear that an institution cannot meet obligations.
